items.title: 26 tests fail on Windows at main 6c1c0a74 (Windows CI only compiles them, so nothing shows it)
items.body:
## Summary

`go test -tags nogui -count=1 ./...` on Windows 11 at `6c1c0a74` (= `origin/main`, fetched 2026-10-12) fails 26 tests in 8 packages. Windows CI runs `go test -run '^$' ./...` plus a short list of named tests, so none of these runs there. The workflow's comment says why ("Some tests fake a home through $HOME, which Windows doesn't read"). This issue lists what that leaves red, so later PRs can point to it instead of saying "the same on main".

Setup: Go 1.26.8 (`GOTOOLCHAIN=local`), Bun 1.4.2 on PATH, checkout with LF line endings (`git -c core.autocrlf=false worktree add --detach <dir> 6c1c0a74`). With the default `core.autocrlf=true` checkout, `TestPurposeAssetMatchesUsage` and `TestRedactKindsAreRedacts` (internal/gui) fail too; they pass on LF, so they are left out here.

## Failing tests, grouped by what the error points to

The groups are read from the error messages. **No cause below has been traced in code**; each is what the message suggests.

**A. The code reads Windows' APPDATA, the test moved only the home** (the folder found is under testenv's shared `AppData\Roaming`, not the test's own dir)
- internal/agent: `TestAlmaServerKeyed` (`alma_test.go:457`), `TestVSCodeInsiders` (`vscode_test.go:256: insiders dir …\magpie-test-home-…\AppData\Roaming\Code - Insiders\User outside …\TestVSCodeInsiders…`), `TestVSCodium` (`vscode_test.go:325`), `TestZedRelativeConfigDirUsesDefault` (`zed_test.go:405`).
- Probably the same: `TestSuffixModesReachAgentFiles` (`suffix_mode_test.go:78: on, codex: map[]`), and `TestCodexDaemonHelperIsNoStaleCopy`, `TestCodexStaleCopiesSayWhichIsLeft`, `TestCodexStaleOnlyForMagpiesChange` (`connect_stale_test.go`: 0 stale, want 1; `copies: []`).

**B. Unix file modes used to make a write fail** (a write the test expects to be refused succeeds on Windows)
- internal/agent: `TestAsideOfflineProviderWriteFailureRollsBackAllFiles` (`:530: provider write should fail`), `TestAsideOfflineWriteFailureRollsBack` (`:321: expected write refusal … <nil>`), `TestAsidePostReadFailuresNeverOfferOffline` (`:154`), `TestAsideDisconnectUnavailableOnlyAtInitialRead` (`:365`), `TestAsideOfflineLegacyRecordDoesNotResurrect` (`:298: record mode`), `TestAsideOfflineRestoresCompleteSelectionsAndPreservesUserChanges` (`:219: record mode`).

**C. A file still held by a running process, or a rename refused**
- internal/gui: `TestGatewayFixQuitsOnlyAMagpie` (`gateway_takeover_test.go:131: take-over: {OK:false Reason:stuck …\magpie.exe}`), `TestGatewayHeldByAContainer` (`TempDir RemoveAll cleanup: unlinkat …\magpie.exe: Access is denied.`).
- magpie (root): `TestPluginListSaysMiddleware` (`unlinkat …\magpie: The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process.`).
- internal/plugin: `TestLoadConcurrentWithSavesAndEdits` (`store_test.go:281: rename …\.plugins.json.N …\plugins.json: Access is denied.`).

**D. A fake executable that isn't a Windows program**
- internal/gui: `TestUpdateThatWontStart` (`update_blocked_test.go:71: relaunched 0 times`; the run logs `fork/exec …\magpie.new: %1 is not a valid Win32 application`).

**E. Each on its own**
- internal/gateway: `TestClaudeAsRootEnv` (`claude_subscription_root_test.go:128: want … "IS_SANDBOX=1"`). Root detection on Windows.
- internal/netproxy: `TestIPv4Fallback` (`v4fallback_test.go:65: dial tcp [::1]:…: connectex: An attempt was made to access a socket in a way forbidden by its access permissions.`). Possibly a port in Windows' excluded range.
- magpie (root): `TestPluginOnOffRmShortName` (`plugin_middleware_cli_test.go:59: off by short name: err no plugin "zz-tags"`).
- internal/usage: `TestDesktopSessionAccountMetadata` (`session_provider_test.go:86: Code tab account mapping`).

**F. Intermittent on Windows** (re-run on HEAD, on an otherwise idle machine)
- internal/provider: `TestLoginUsageClaudeAskedMeanwhile`: 13 of 20 runs fail (`claude_usage_fallback_test.go:263: a reading from before the ask was kept`). This test does run on Linux and macOS CI (the "Race account usage" step), so if it fails only on Windows, that may point to clock granularity. Not checked.
- internal/gateway: `TestQueuedStreamKeptAliveOnceSentToItsVendor/responses`: 1 of 10 (`queue_keepalive_test.go:322: the agent wasn't kept alive before the vendor was asked`). Related to the queued-stream timing fixed in 3f4287e6.
- internal/agent: `TestWSLClaudeFollowerOnTheMainModelIsNoDrift`: failed in one full run (`claude_follow_drift_test.go:115`), passed in the next.

## Not known

- No cause has been confirmed in code; the groups above come only from the messages.
- Whether Windows Defender or the indexer holds files in group C: not checked.
- Linux and macOS results for groups A–E: not checked here. CI is green there, so these look Windows-only.

## Proposed

Each group is a fix of its own. A and B may mostly be test isolation, not product bugs: group A's code may be right to read APPDATA. Each fix should say which it was.
